sect1.title: DESCRIPTION
sect1.para: This TimestampUtil static class, together with dtn_time_t (BPv6), bpv6_creation_timestamp_t (BPv6) and bpv7_creation_timestamp_t (BPv7) provide a means to work with bundle times using boost::posix_time objects and its microsecond clock.
